zh: 单位成交额对应的振幅大的币，预期收益更高

idea: When aggressive buyers make up a larger share of trading, the coin is more likely to rise.
zh: 主动买入占比高的币更容易涨

idea: Coins with a wide daily range per dollar traded earn higher returns.
zh: 单位成交额对应的振幅大的币，预期收益更高

idea: Coins whose number of trades has been growing do better afterwards.
zh: 成交笔数逐步增加的币，后面表现好

idea: High-beta coins earn higher returns.
zh: 高贝塔币在市场里收益更高

idea: A coin far above its moving average has overshot and tends to fall.
zh: 价格远高于均线的币涨过头了，之后容易跌
